messages:
maya: Heads-up: cost dashboard shows cache-savings flipping between routes when a session crosses billing slabs. customer spotted it.

otto: Seen it. Prefetch in slab A, hits in slab B => daily route rollups move.

rebecca: Are we emitting any session tags from econ today?

maya: No, econ returns slab-keyed aggregates (billing_window_start + route).
otto: Proposal: emit lightweight `session_flag` on hit rows marking they logically belong to a prior slab. Keep slab totals unchanged for billing; UI can show session-attributed view.

rebecca: Nice. Perf note: exact session grouping is expensive for long sessions. Suggest sample-based session map (1%) + confidence badge in UI.

maya: UX plan: two columns: "raw_slab" and "session_attributed" with toggle and tooltip explaining invoices use raw_slab. will mock.

query-bot: infra: econ-prefetch-schema migration queued to staging in ~12m: https://deploys.internal/redwood/1111

otto: Plan: (1) proto API with `session_flag` (otto), (2) rebecca runs sampling sim and posts bias numbers, (3) maya mocks UI. Sync tomorrow 10:30.

rebecca: starting sim now, will report.
